recognize_zh: 小腸黏膜低中倍：絨毛短鈍、形狀扭曲，固有層被密集淋巴樣細胞塞滿並侵入腺體上皮，部分黏膜碎裂脫落；此黏膜內密集浸潤搭配絨毛破壞，符合腸病相關 T 細胞淋巴瘤的切片型態。
features: Blunted, irregular villi with distorted crypts
Dense cellular infiltrate expanding the lamina propria
Infiltrating cells permeate glandular and surface epithelium
Fragmented, partly detached mucosal strips; high-power cytology not assessable
describe_en: Section of small-intestinal mucosa at low-to-medium power shows blunted, irregular villi and distorted crypts, with the lamina propria expanded by a dense lymphoid infiltrate that permeates the surface and glandular epithelium. Mucosal vessels are congested, and portions of the mucosa are fragmented. Cellular detail is limited at this magnification. In correlation with cytologic atypia and T-cell immunophenotype, findings are consistent with enteropathy-associated T-cell lymphoma.

ddx.vs: Celiac disease has villous atrophy with crypt hyperplasia and bland intraepithelial lymphocytes but no expansile atypical T-cell infiltrate.
Inflammatory enteritis shows a mixed infiltrate with neutrophils, cryptitis and granulomas rather than a monotonous lymphoid population.

ddx.dx: MALT lymphoma of the small bowel
ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma forms lymphoepithelial lesions with CD20+ centrocyte-like B cells, whereas EATL cells are CD3+ T cells.
